segments.text: I Now proceed to show how he accomplished this success. Here I would observe, that this success consists in two things, viz either in grace, or in glory. That success which consists in the former, is to be seen in those work• of God which are wrought during those ages of the church wherein the church is continued under the outward means of grace. That success which consists in the latter of these, v•z glory: has its chief accomplishment at the day of judgement.
